refero:6310.summary: From an empty Upcoming schedule, open Add a Class, pick a catalog service (duration/location inherited), set start + weekly days, Create, and see series cards live with capacity and a publish toast.
steps: Add a Class drawer · service + start
Live toast · Power Yoga is now live
steal: Steps 1–3: Service/catalog pick inherits duration + location into a summary card — only start time and repeat left to set before Create.
Steps 4–5: Repeat presets (Does not repeat / Weekly / Every 2–4 weeks) then Mon–Sun day chips expand only when Weekly is on.
Steps 1 & 5: Live sentence summary ('…from 10:00 to 10:45, starting on Jul 5') confirms end time without a separate end field.
Step 6: Post-create toast 'Power Yoga is now live! Clients can now book…' marks publish, not just save.
avoid: Agenda list only — no week/resource grid, so room/faculty double-book can’t be spotted while creating.
refero:6310.fit: Cheap simple-event path: scenario-as-catalog service → default duration/room → weekly day chips for N sessions; extends Baseline simple events, not flexi cell assignment.

refero:6311.summary: Open a class from Upcoming, Cancel booking, choose this occurrence vs all future classes, then see a Canceled badge retained on the list with a success toast.
steps: Scope modal · this vs all future
steal: Step 2: Scope dialog — 'Cancel only this class' (primary red) vs 'Cancel all future classes - on at 15:00' plus copy that booked clients can rebook.
Steps 3–4: Occurrence stays on the agenda with red 'Canceled' badge (and struck time) instead of vanishing — schedule history remains visible.
Step 1: Booking details splits Clients into Attending / Cancelled tabs before the cancel action.
avoid: No on-screen invitee notification confirmation — only organizer-side cancel; don’t assume attendee email UX from this flow.
refero:6311.fit: Reuse for session-series cancel scope (one run vs rest of rotation) with cancel-in-place badge for coordinators; comparable to Amie/Motion this/all, but organizer-cancel framed.
